# TRAVNY hub / TVP Live IPTV

> TVPI is the landing hub for a small family of public tools: live Polish public television, a local weather dashboard, self-updating feeds, and two browser-based workbenches. The hub itself also publishes ready-to-use TVP M3U/HLS playlists.

Use the sections below to choose the right service instead of treating the homepage as only an IPTV player.

## Hub map

- [TVPI homepage](https://tvpi.pages.dev/): visual hub and TVP channel directory
- [TV player](https://tvpi.pages.dev/tv/): browser playback for the current TVP streams
- [Weather](https://weather.travny.workers.dev/): multi-source local weather ensemble for Kościelec in Chrzanów, including temperature, wind, humidity, air quality and pollen
- [Feeds](https://trvny.github.io/feeds/): self-updating Atom/RSS directory with 55+ feeds regenerated every two hours; [LLM guide](https://trvny.github.io/feeds/llms.txt)
- [Streambench](https://streambench.travny.workers.dev/): browser workshop for IPTV, internet radio, HLS, M3U/M3U8 and XMLTV EPG; [LLM guide](https://streambench.travny.workers.dev/llms.txt)
- [Codebench](https://codebench.travny.workers.dev/): local QR and barcode studio for generating, reading and exporting machine-readable codes

## TVP playlists

TVP stream URLs use short-lived signatures, so the Worker endpoint is preferred. The raw GitHub mirror is a periodically refreshed fallback.

- [Combined playlist — Worker](https://tvpi.travny.workers.dev/playlist.m3u): all channels, resolved fresh on every request
- [Combined playlist — raw mirror](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/trvny/tvpi/main/streams/playlist.m3u): static snapshot refreshed every 15 minutes

## Project roles

### TVPI

Use for discovering and watching TVP channels or obtaining the combined M3U playlist. At present, 8 of 9 channels are degraded because TVP rejects the server-side API requests made by both the Worker and GitHub Actions; the hosted endpoints therefore return stale fallbacks even to viewers in Poland.

### Weather

Use for the local Chrzanów/Kościelec forecast and environmental readings. It combines several sources rather than exposing a single-provider forecast.

### Feeds

Use when a site lacks a convenient native feed. The directory publishes Atom/RSS files, an OPML bundle, a browser reader, a sitemap and its own `llms.txt`.

### Streambench

Use for testing or editing stream URLs and playlists locally in the browser. It supports direct playback, public catalogues, local files, pasted playlists, diagnostics, favourites, hidden items, exports and optional XMLTV EPG.

### Codebench

Use for creating and scanning QR codes and barcodes. Processing is designed to stay in the browser where supported.
